# `fara_registrants`

**FARA registrant observations**

One registrant record in an explicitly selected production export.

**Coverage.** Sampled by design. Every record for the explicitly selected native registration numbers in each pinned production bulk export is retained, including historical filings and terminated relationships. Capture descriptors define the observed snapshot; separate exports are not an atomic publisher release. Principal entity IDs are not supplied. Exact label associations do not establish identity or documentary agreement. Linked documents outside the explicit selection remain unfetched; document review notes preserve differences. This is bounded local qualification, not evidence of public delivery or publisher-wide historical completeness. *(measured 2026-11-13)*

- **Parquet file:** `fara_registrants.parquet`
- **MCP `query_sql` support:** Configured; requires an available artifact.
- **Publication status:** Not established by this schema page or its measurement date.
- **Row count:** Not stated here; the MCP `describe_table` reply gives the live count under `publication`.

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `registration_number` | `VARCHAR` | Native registration number preserved as text, including leading zeros. Repeated registrations remain separate observations. |
| `registrant_name` | `VARCHAR` | Literal registrant name; no name normalization or cross-source identity resolution. |
| `registration_date` | `DATE` | Parsed source registration date; original text and absent/blank/unparsed diagnostics remain available. |
| `termination_date` | `DATE` | Parsed source termination date; null alone does not establish current activity. |
| `registration_status` | `VARCHAR` | Date-derived status: terminated, no_termination_reported, or unresolved. No termination reported is not independently verified active status. |
| `date_diagnostics_json` | `VARCHAR` | Per-date parse status: value, absent, blank or unparsed; original fields remain unchanged. |
| `source_record_id` | `VARCHAR` | Export kind, exact original digest and row ordinal. Identifies an observation, not an inferred entity. |
| `source_release_digest` | `VARCHAR` | Exact admitted SpicyDocs source-release digest. |
| `source_locator_json` | `VARCHAR` | Original URL, digest, capture time, ZIP member digest and original XML XPath or CSV line coordinates. Encoding corrections are explicit. |
| `raw_fields_json` | `VARCHAR` | Literal native field names and values. Absent XML fields stay absent; empty elements stay empty strings; unknown fields survive. |
